 Arab Weather - The Kingdom and the Levant region in general are experiencing a period of warmth and stability, as a result of the dominance of strong high-pressure systems in the upper layers of the atmosphere, which work to reduce the chances of the formation of low-pressure systems and weather disturbances, and push towards the continuation of stable weather and temperatures higher than their usual averages at some times.
 A rise in atmospheric pressure values over large parts of Europe and indications of a change in weather systems. 
 Looking at the weather systems in the northern hemisphere, we note an increase in surface atmospheric pressure values over large areas of the European continent, especially central and northern Europe, a development that deserves to be monitored in light of its potential repercussions on the movement of weather systems and the paths of air masses during the coming period. 
 Strong high-pressure systems are affecting the Levant region these days. 
 Some weather indicators suggest the possibility of positive changes in weather systems during the last days of November and the beginning of December. These changes may contribute to reorganizing weather patterns in Europe and the Mediterranean basin, which may increase the chances of colder air masses moving towards the eastern Mediterranean basin, and perhaps the return of cold winter weather and rain to the Kingdom, the Levant, and northern Egypt.
 Promising signs, but details remain unclear. 
 Despite these positive indicators, the features of the potential weather changes are still not sufficiently clear at this moment, and it is not possible to determine their timing or the nature of their effects on our region, as they still need more time for their details to become clear through the upcoming weather updates. 
 Signs of a return of cold air masses and rain 
 But what we are currently observing is an improvement in weather systems, which may open the way for positive changes in the movement of air masses during the coming period, and we hope for good news, while emphasizing the need to follow weather developments first-hand.
 We ask God to send us rain and not make us among those who despair, and to make what is coming good and blessed. We hope to increase supplication and seeking forgiveness, asking God to have mercy on the country and the people with beneficial rain.
 And God knows best.
